title: Google Review snippet
statusNote: Active. Review and AggregateRating can be standalone (with itemReviewed) or nested in a parent type through review / aggregateRating.
notes: Not checked: a standalone Review or AggregateRating requires itemReviewed and itemReviewed.name. When it is nested in the reviewed item, the parent name is required instead, so these are not checked.
Nested review/aggregateRating: itemReviewed is omitted (parent is the reviewed item) but the parent's name is still required. itemReviewed.name or parent name required.

Valid itemReviewed types: Book, Course, CreativeWorkSeason, CreativeWorkSeries, Episode, Event, Game, HowTo, LocalBusiness, MediaObject, Movie, MusicPlaylist, MusicRecording, Organization, Product, Recipe, SoftwareApplication. author is Person or Organization; name must be a valid name and shorter than 100 chars, else not eligible for an author-based snippet. ratingValue: Number or Text (number, fraction, or percentage); default scale 1-5; dot decimal separator; bestRating default 5, worstRating default 1 (not warned by the Rich Results Test).
AggregateRating: at least one of ratingCount or reviewCount.
